messages.内置预览与简单编辑。动图编辑只保留当前静态画面；编辑长边最多 4096 px，另: Built-in preview and simple editing. Editing animated images saves a still frame. Edits are limited to 4096 px on the longer side and saved as PNG / JPEG. WebP / AVIF thumbnails may show a format icon.
messages.可以收录和分类，使用系统图片应用打开；不承诺内置预览或编辑。: Can be imported and organized. Open with a system photo app; built-in preview and editing are not guaranteed.
messages.MP3、PCM WAV、FLAC、Vorbis / Opus 和 AAC 等取决: MP3, PCM WAV, FLAC, Vorbis / Opus and AAC support depends on the actual encoding and WebView2. Containers such as WAV may contain unsupported codecs.
messages.可以收录到专辑，建议使用系统播放器。: Can be organized into albums. A system player is recommended.
messages.内置 PDF 预览、文字层、标记与位置插入；扫描件不提供 OCR。批注保存在 k: Built-in PDF preview, text layer, annotations and positioned text. No OCR for scans. Annotations are saved in kok, not written into the original PDF.
messages.提取正文阅读、插入与批注，不保留 Office 原始排版、图片、表格布局或宏。: Extracts body text for reading, insertion and annotation. Original Office layout, images, table layout and macros are not preserved.
messages.按纯文本阅读，Markdown / HTML 不渲染排版，CSV 不显示电子表格: Read as plain text. Markdown / HTML formatting is not rendered, and CSV is not shown as a spreadsheet. Supports UTF-8, UTF-16 and GB18030.
messages.可以收录和分类，使用已安装的 Office、WPS 或其他系统应用打开。: Can be imported and organized. Open with an installed copy of Office, WPS or another system app.
messages.无 DRM 的 EPUB 正文与 TXT 分节阅读；EPUB 不还原图片、复杂排: Reads DRM-free EPUB body text and TXT sections. EPUB images, complex layout and interactive footnotes are not reproduced. TXT supports UTF-8, UTF-16 and GB18030.
messages.可以收录和分类，使用系统阅读器；不解密 DRM。: Can be imported and organized. Use a system reader; DRM is not decrypted.
messages.字幕仅支持外挂文字文件；SUB 仅支持 MicroDVD。ASS / SSA 不: External text subtitles only; SUB means MicroDVD. ASS / SSA effects are not rendered, and TTML uses basic timing. Embedded subtitle extraction and speech recognition are not included.
messages.字体可导入 TTF / OTF，单个文件最多 20 MB。照片另存 PNG /: Import TTF / OTF fonts up to 20 MB each. Save edited photos as PNG / JPEG, annotations as HTML, and translations as TXT / SRT.
messages.系统应用入口需要已安装相应软件。kok 不包含外部播放器、Office、OCR: External app actions require suitable software to be installed. kok does not bundle external players, Office, OCR or DRM decryption tools.
messages.推荐 H.264 / AAC 的 MP4，或 VP8 / VP9 / Opus: Use MP4 with H.264 / AAC, or WebM with VP8 / VP9 / Opus. MKV requires decodable tracks; multiple audio track selection is not provided. A file extension does not guarantee playback; HEVC, AV1 and other codecs depend on the runtime, system and hardware.
